messages:
Devon: Wrapping up my shift, but INC-876 (embedding service latency) is still active. I can stay for ~10 more mins to hand off. Current state: error rate ~3%, tail latency spikes at 800ms, customers A & C seeing elevated 5xx. Paging still on.
Anita: I can take primary if you're good with it. I've reviewed the last 30m of logs and the KV cache misses jumped after the deploy.
Devon: Yep, that matches my notes. I ran the partial rollback but didn't fully stabilize. I'll hand you driver and set comms to Jamie.
Jamie: Happy to take comms (customer updates + incident channel). I'll draft an initial status for Affected Customers.
Ops-Bot: INCIDENT INC-876 severity: P1 created by monitoring. Alerts: embedding-service > 95th latency threshold. Pager notifications sent to oncall@redwood. Link: https://ops.redwood/incidents/INC-876
Maya: Quick heads-up — we have a gap at 02:00 UTC where Dedicated oncall rotates; if the timeline goes past that, we should ensure secondary coverage.
Devon: Good catch. Anita, can you stay on as secondary through 02:30 UTC if needed? We have no-one on immediate standby because Liam's on-call block ends at 02:05 and he has an overlapping leave.
Anita: I can do 02:30. If it persists past that, escalate to oncall-tier2 and call out for extra hands.
Liam: I'm reachable for 15 more mins if something spikes after the handoff, but I'll be offline after 02:05.
Jamie: Drafted customer-facing note: "We're investigating intermittent latency in embeddings. Engineers are diagnosing a cache-eviction regression after a recent deploy. Temporary mitigation: increased KV cache size and reverting suspect change. Next update in 20m." Want me to post to status page?
Devon: Yes post to status page and @customer-success. Keep wording conservative — avoid promising ETA.
Anita: Runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embedding-latency. Also recommend following the rollback snippet under "Quick rollback" and then validate with `curl` checks in the playbook.
Jamie: Posted to status page and pinged @cust-success. Added note that we're doing a canary rollback now.
Devon: Handoff sequence: 1) Anita = primary driver, 2) Jamie = comms owner, 3) Devon = warm backup for 10m, 4) Maya monitor coverage gap and escalate to tier2 at 02:10 if not resolved.
Anita: Acknowledged. I'll run the rollback steps and post progress every 10 minutes. If rollback fails, I'll trigger the failover plan in the runbook.
Ops-Bot: HANDOFF recorded: previous_primary=Devon, new_primary=Anita, comms_owner=Jamie, handoff_ts=1745301180. Pager routing updated.
Jamie: I'm on incident bridge: https://meet.redwood/s/INC-876. Putting a short comms template in the thread: `Status: Investigating; Impact: Partial embeddings degradation for some customers; Mitigation: Rolling back deploy; Next update: in ~10m`.
Devon: Leaving notes: logs collected at s3://redwood-logs/incidents/INC-876/174530. Saved heap/profile dumps and kv-cache snapshots.
Maya: I've scheduled a bullet in the midnight oncall rotation to check this if still open — ping me if you need me to push earlier.
Anita: Starting rollback now. Command I ran: ```bash
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/embedding-service embedding=embedding:v1.4.2
kubectl rollout status deploy/embedding-service --timeout=5m
```
Jamie: Noted. I'll update customers after rollback status. Also tagging PMs: @product for high-level heads-up.
Devon: Thanks all. If anything urgent pops within my login window I'll jump back in, otherwise Anita/Jamie you're owners. Leaving the channel — good handoff. :thumbsup:
Jamie: Confirmed handoff and ownership. Monitoring comms and status.
Anita: Confirmed primary. Starting post-rollback validation now.
Ops-Bot: INCIDENT INC-876 status changed: mitigation_in_progress -> rolling_rollback. Updated at 1745301745.
Jamie: After rollback traffic looks healthier in the canary (p95 down to 120ms). Preparing next customer update in 5m.
Anita: Canary good. Promoting rollback to majority nodes. Continuing to monitor.
Maya: If rollback holds, let's schedule a follow-up postmortem and add a test for the eviction edge-case to the integration suite.
Liam: Thanks for the smooth handoff — will catch up on the postmortem notes tomorrow.
Jamie: Final note for thread: handoff complete, primary=Anita (active), comms=Jamie, backup=Devon (until 1745301780), coverage gap noted at 02:00 UTC addressed with Maya on standby.
Anita: Closing handoff — will update channel when incident is resolved.
